messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired for service="gpu-hosts" severity=critical — event_id=PD-78129 — description=kernel panic detected on host gpu-03.rack-7 (auto-escalation to eng-oncall)

pagerduty: ALERT: PD-78129 -> gpu-03.rack-7 kernel panic. Acknowledge within 5m. Incident link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-78129

Maya Chen: acked — I'm oncall and taking this. tagging infra if host-level required.

Nate Patel: taking over initial triage. running kubectl get nodes & describe node

Nate Patel: ```
$ kubectl get nodes | grep gpu-03
gpu-03.rack-7   NotReady   <none>   12d   v1.26.3
```

Arun Gupta: I pulled the host console logs (via our host-agent). dmesg shows OOPS and stack trace around nv_peer_mem: kernel panic. Excerpt:

Arun Gupta: ```
[113245.678901] kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
[113245.679012] CPU: 3 PID: 2245 Comm: nvidia-persist
[113245.679123] Call Trace:
[113245.679234]  dump_stack+0x5c/0x9a
[113245.679345]  panic+0x1f6/0x4b0
[113245.679456]  ? nv_peer_mem_fault_handler+0x90/0x120
```

Priya Rao: 1) cordon + drain plan ready. 2) Evict model-serving pods gracefully, let autoscaler pick up. My suggested commands:

Priya Rao: ```
kubectl cordon gpu-03.rack-7
kubectl drain gpu-03.rack-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force --grace-period=60
```

Zack Lee: running drain now. note: a few long-running inferences on model-xl may be interrupted; LB has failover to other nodes and API retries enabled. watching queue backlog.

Zack Lee: drain output:

Zack Lee: ```
node/gpu-03.rack-7 cordoned
pod/model-serving-xyz deleted
pod/redis-cache-abc deleted
...
```

Maya Chen: customer impact assessment: Observability shows ~4.2% increase in 5xxs for generation endpoints in us-west-2 from 11:03 to 11:12 UTC. Most requests recovered via automatic retry -> fallback model-small. No SSO or billing errors detected. Notifying CS for any high-value customers on affected hosts.

Nate Patel: Created infra ticket INFRA-4021, attached host console logs and PD event. Requesting reprovision/reimage of gpu-03.rack-7.

incident-bot: PD-78129 -> acknowledged by Maya Chen. Escalation timer paused.

Arun Gupta: quick mitigation note: kernel panic appears tied to NV driver + kernel combo after recent rolling upgrade on rack-7. Recommend hold rolling upgrades for similar racks until repro confirmed.

Priya Rao: added temporary autoscaler bump for us-west-2 (scale-up=+2 GPUs) to reduce risk while host is reprovisioned. Monitoring now.

Zack Lee: traffic has shifted, backlog cleared. currently 0 nodes in NotReady. confirmed by kube metrics. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: handing off to infra for host reprovision/reboot. ETA for reprovision start 11:35 UTC, ETA completion ~ 11:55 UTC. I'll follow up when host returns.

Nate Patel: logging follow-up steps for postmortem: timeline, root cause hypothesis (nv driver/kernel regression), mitigation (drain/cordon, autoscaler bump, hold rolling upgrade), and customer impact (4.2% 5xx for 9m). Assigning action items to infra and releases team.

Maya Chen: handing off final operations to oncall-morning (Arun will be primary morning contact). If host doesn't come back by 12:10 UTC escalate to SRE lead.

Arun Gupta: noted. I'll take next watch. leaving a short checklist for morning oncall:
- verify reprovision completed and host back in Ready
- validate model-serving pods redistributed and no stuck PVs
- roll-forward/rollback decision for kernel upgrades
- postmortem draft in #incidents within 24h

Maya Chen: thanks team. closing slack thread once infra confirms host healthy. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: PD-78129 -> resolved by user at 11:58 UTC (manual resolve after host reprovision completed)

Zack Lee: final note: host gpu-03.rack-7 reprovisioned and rejoined cluster at 11:57 UTC. kubelet reported Ready. marking in ticket.

Maya Chen: thread closed, will create postmortem doc and link in #incidents.
